title: xAI · 更新日志来源更新

added_lines: Grok Voice 1.0 is now available with the Speech to Speech API. To get started, check out the Speech to Speech docs. For more details, see our blog post.
grok-voice-2.0 is deprecated. To upgrade, set model to grok-voice-3.0 or grok-voice-latest, at the same price. See Upgrading from Grok Voice 2.0.

grok-voice-2.0 is now available with Speech to Speech. grok-voice-latest will route to this model starting August 5, 2026. To get started, see the Speech to Speech docs. For more details, see our announcement.

grok-voice-3.0 is now available with Speech to Speech, at the same price as Grok Voice 2.0. grok-voice-latest now points to grok-voice-3.0, so sessions that use the alias are upgraded automatically. The API is unchanged. To get started, see the Speech to Speech docs.
removed_lines: Grok Voice Think Fast 1.0 is available
Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 is available
You can now use grok-voice-think-fast-1.0 with the Speech to Speech API. To get started, check out the Speech to Speech docs. For more details, see our blog post.

grok-voice-think-fast-2.0 is now available with Speech to Speech. grok-voice-latest will route to this model starting August 5, 2026. To get started, see the Speech to Speech docs. For more details, see our announcement.
